response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang skills, but the profile is fundamentally mismatched with this embedded networking security role. He lacks the required native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, minimal recent C/UNIX systems work, and no background in network security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X), L2/L3 switching, or embedded firmware for networking products.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, and some systems-level work
Some low-level experience: C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, Linux familiarity
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source contributions demonstrating craftsmanship
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, a hard requirement (native level) for this role
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, security protocol (MACsec, 802.1X), or Linux kernel modification experience
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack (TypeScript, React, Node.js), far from embedded C firmware development

key_factors.factor: General software engineering seniority and systems exposure
